open: dixi.fi could not be read (robots.txt blocks automated fetching), so tenant floors/hours are from OSM; the web-search budget ran out before the shops' own sites could be looked up.

Which Dixi 3rd-floor shops count as the 'station part' is not stated by any source read; the list keeps the bridge-floor shops nearest the platforms and leaves out the rest of the mall (S-market and Picnic are kept as traveller-relevant).
Position of the luggage lockers (VR: available) not found.
Bus terminal: VR says the Tikkurila terminal closes from 9 February (year not stated) and buses use temporary terminals; current stop positions not settled.
R-kioski Tikkurila Piletti (Ratatie 16, Mo-Fr 06-20, Sa-Su 10-19 per r-kioski.fi) is outside Dixi; left out.

Platform 1 (V0618 in OSM) access: OSM shows an underpass and stairs; lift n3293095423 is a Dixi building lift. Not confirmed. [Lift follow-up 2026-10-30: n3293095423 is 2.0 m from the V0618 (platform 1) outline but tagged levels 1;3;4;5;6 as a building lift. OSM has no other lift at platform 1. Platform 1 step-free access is not settled.]

answers.question: (no open-question list for Finland yet; brief: only the station-related part of Dixi and the routes to the platforms)
answers.answer: The station hall is the bridge over the tracks on Dixi's 3rd floor (VR), open 05-02 as the waiting area. Platforms 1–6 (Digitraffic). VR says platforms are reached by lift or escalator; OSM maps from the bridge one lift, an escalator pair and stairs to each island (2/3, 4/5) and to 6, plus an underpass with more lifts. R-kioski hours from r-kioski.fi; other shop hours OSM only.
